Entry Social Hierarchy of the Crownlands Entry Social Hierarchy of the Crownlands The nobles are close to the Iron Throne here, while the citizens and merchants are more directly exposed to decrees, golden robes, and price changes; the same set of order may appear natural in the hall, but extraordinarily strange in the fields, docks, or beside the campfire Whether it is valid depends on who can grant the rights, collect the consideration, and actually make the judgment come to fruition in the event of default.

Entry Social Hierarchy of the Crownlands Entry Social Hierarchy of the Crownlands The nobles are close to the Iron Throne here, while the citizens and merchants are more directly exposed to decrees, golden robes, and price changes; the same set of order may appear natural in the hall, but extraordinarily strange in the fields, docks, or beside the campfire The distant system is not empty talk only if it can be implemented in campfires, city gates and inns.

Entry Social Hierarchy of the Crownlands Entry Social Hierarchy of the Crownlands The nobles are close to the Iron Throne here, while the citizens and merchants are more directly exposed to decrees, golden robes, and price changes; the same set of order may appear natural in the hall, but extraordinarily strange in the fields, docks, or beside the campfire If a rule is practiced over and over again, it will find its way into rituals, crafts, and prayers; if it is sustained only by fear, cracks will show at the onset of a crisis.
